(2) From and after the date of commencement of this Act,
members  of  the  Thareeqathul  Aroosiyyathil  Qaadhiriyyah

(3) From and after the date of commencement of this Act,
the list of institutions vested with the Association including
those  institutions  set  out  in  the  First  Schedule  to  this  Act
shall hereinafter be vested with the Corporation.
(4)  Any  property,  right  or  thing  vested,  belonging,
dedicated  or  associated  with  the  Spiritual  Head  or
Association  from  and  after  the  date  of  commencement  of
this Act, shall be vested with the Corporation.

3.
The general objects of  the Corporation are hereby
declared to be—

(a)
to administer and supervise all Mosques, Thakkiyas,
Madrasas, Charitable Trusts, Muslim Shrines and
Places  of  Religious  resort  and  other  institutions
vested, belonging, dedicated or associated with the
Association  founded  by  His  Holiness  Qutbuz
Zaman  Madihus  Sibtain  Al-Allama  As-Shaikh
Imamul Aroos Sayyid Muhammad Mapillai Lebbai
Alim Waliyullah and his successors;

(b)
to appoint, remove and exercise control over trustees
appointed  to  the  list  of  institutions  set  out  in  the
